resources.string: A notification when you are near a store and the list has things on it

Tandem can remind you when you are near one of your stores and something is still on the shopping list. Set where each store is once; Tandem watches those places with the phone\'s location service, without following you.
At most once per visit, within the distance you choose. Off by default.
Set where a store is below to get the reminder.
Stores (supermarkets) are set up in Tandoor on the web. Once there is one, it shows here.
The places stay on this phone
They are never sent to your server or anywhere else, and they go when the account is removed from Tandem. Turning the reminder off stops all watching.
The reminder near the store needs your own stores and shopping list. Log in to your Tandoor to use it.
The reminder uses the stores and the shopping list of your Tandoor account.

The reminder near the store uses Google Play services to notice, without draining the battery, when the phone comes near a store. This phone does not have them (or has an old version), so the option is not available. Everything else in Tandem works as usual.
Place saved %1$s from a pasted place
I\'m in the store now – use my position
Or paste a geo: link, a map link or coordinates.
No place found in the text. Try coordinates with decimals or a geo: link.

The reminder comes when you get near a store, also when Tandem is not open. Android now opens the settings: choose “Allow all the time”. Tandem only uses the location to notice when you are near the stores you chose; it is never sent anywhere.
Without the phone\'s location Tandem cannot notice when you are near a store, or use your position as a store\'s place. You can still paste a place.
With approximate location the phone can be off by several kilometres, so the reminder cannot come within a few hundred metres. Choose “Precise” for Tandem.
The reminder comes when Tandem is not open, so it needs location all the time. Open the settings, choose Location and “Allow all the time”.
The reminder is a notification. Allow notifications for Tandem to get it.
The reminder cannot come right now
A permission was taken back in the phone\'s settings (location all the time or notifications). Allow it again to get the reminder.
The phone\'s location is turned off, so no store is watched. Turn it on and Tandem starts again by itself.
Google Play services did not take the stores this time. Tandem tries again the next time it starts.
The reminder near the store is on
The reminder near the store is off
Place saved. Turn the reminder on at the top to get it.
No position came. Try again by a window or outdoors, or paste the place.
Turn on the phone\'s location first
That did not work. Try again.
